Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the authority of state entities to purchase land strictly for conservation purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to purchase of land by state agencies; and addinga new section to chapter 79.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A state agency or department may not purchase in fee simple aprivately owned parcel of land in excess of five contiguous acres inany county for habitat conservation, ecosystem preservation, wetlandmitigation, or endangered species protection except under theprovisions of subsections (2) and (3) of this section. (2) An agency may purchase more than five contiguous acres underthe provisions of this section if: (a) The appropriate countylegislative authority or authorities have been given the opportunity tohold a public hearing on the transaction; and (b) following the countylegislative authorities hearing, the legislature takes specific actiondirecting the agency to make the purchase. (3) When land is purchased by a state agency or department, theagency or department must post a bond or otherwise financially p. 1 SSB 5518guarantee that the land will be managed for the control of noxiousweeds.
